newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Parker & Parsley reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Parker & Parsley reiterated.

text.p: - JP Morgan analysts Michael Cha and Haera Lee have reiterated their buy recommendation on Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co saying the company is trading on four times estimated 1997 cash flow against six times for its peer group.

- "We reiterate our buy recommendation of PDP shares based on its compelling cash flow and reserve growth story and believe that the shares should trade at a minimum five times estimated 1997 cash flow and a 10 percent premium to its current NAV of $35, leading to a $37-$39 price target," the analysts said.
Parker & Parsley was trading off 1/8 at $30 1/4 at 1028 EST. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
